connector.name: Ivy Wolf
connector.description: Lets your assistant read the ideas, threads, to-dos and interview chapters you've captured in Ivy Wolf, and add a new idea. Read-only except for adding ideas; every answer links back into the Ivy app.
examplePrompts: What ideas did I have this week?
What do I keep coming back to?
What did Mara say about pricing in Tuesday's interview?
Add an idea: open the restock video on the box, not my face.
What's on my list from the drive?
